meta.upstream: NIST SARD Juliet Test Suite for C/C++ v1.3 (CWE-121/122/124/126/127 subset)
meta.fetched_via: GitHub contents API, testcases/<CWE>/<sNN>/ directory listings, 2026-08-20
meta.unit: a (cwe, mechanism) row is one vulnerability-mechanism family (e.g. CWE121/CWE131_loop); file_count sums every flow-variant file (numeric suffix 01..84, a/b/c/.. splits) Juliet generates for that SAME underlying flaw -- the flow variants change control/data-flow plumbing (globals, threads, separate files, ...), never the arithmetic shape, per Juliet's own documented flow-variant taxonomy; classifying one representative file per mechanism (spot-read, see TRAIN-RESULTS.md) is therefore representative of the whole family.
